# P1.04 — Project list, new-project flow, state surfaces

Spec: `docs/tickets/32_P1.04__project-list-and-new-project.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.04.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (deploy `api` + `web` to `dev`, bounded live
verify, $0 inference) is operator-gated → **D-P1.04-1**.

## Summary

`/app` becomes the §5.2 workspace home — projects grouped by attention (Needs you / Running / Ready to
read / Quiet-collapsed), each row carrying the derived state icon + pill, `vN` version, a deterministic
≤120-char status line, the Voice chip (or *Unfiled*) with its staleness pill, and one state-matched
primary action. The alternate Voice grouping, the Voice/Protocol filters, Sort, and the Archived +
Recently-deleted affordances complete the bar. `+ New project` opens the §5.3 three-entry sheet
(scratch / outline / draft — no fourth entry) with the protocol cards, venue typeahead, and Voice
picker, running the conversion preview on the live PRB.20 path before anything is created. Every row's
state still derives from `projectState` over the row sets — **no `status`/`state` column exists or was
added** (REQ-SPEC-3); `archived_at`/`deleted_at`/`letter_opened_at` are visibility markers, not state.

## What landed

**`apps/api`** — `project-list.ts` is the authoritative assembler (extended, never forked): batched
reads for active runs, terminal failures, gate deadlines, step progress, review findings,
`letter_opened_at`, and Voice chips → one `ProjectListRow` with `group`, `statusLine`, `activeRun`,
`needsYouDeadlineAt`, `lastRunFailed`, `usesOlderProfile`. `project-routes.ts`: `POST /projects` (the
three-entry create — upload entries adopt the preview's quarantined conversion; `startVersion` labels
the first draft, REQ-PROD-8), rename/duplicate/archive/unarchive/delete/restore, `GET/PUT
/settings/project-grouping`, `GET /protocols` (picker metadata only — no protocol bodies leave the
server). `search.ts`: `GET /projects/search?q=` over the new `project_search_docs` tsvector index
(title/Voice/venue/materialized markdown/letters), self-healing the project doc per hit.
`import.ts`: the workspace-scoped preview leg (no project required — the quarantine key carries the
workspace). `dossier-routes.ts` stamps `letter_opened_at` on the letter read → Ready-to-read clears.
`run-routes.ts` refuses `project_archived`.

**`packages/db`** — migration `0029_project_home.sql` (`"user".project_group_by`, `projects.deleted_at`,
`correspondence_items.letter_opened_at`, `project_search_docs` + GIN + tenant RLS) and the matching
Drizzle defs (schema parity restored).

**`packages/protocols`** — `PROTOCOL_CARDS` picker metadata for the four seeded protocols +
`detectApparatus`/`defaultProtocolId`: Essay for Unfiled, Academic when the linked Voice's structure
repertoire records `apparatus: full`, otherwise the sheet asks once (REQ-GENRE-4).

**`apps/web`** — `/app` grouped home (controls bar: search, Group-by persisting per user, Voice chips,
Protocol + Sort dropdowns, Archived + Recently-deleted affordances); `/app/new` three-entry sheet with
protocol cards (tagline / hold-you-to / typical Review estimate), venue datalist + length prefill, and
the Voice picker (No voice default, Your voices / House styles optgroups, shared pills, never-built
hint, *Create a voice…*); the conversion preview renders source-beside-converted with the count line,
anchored warnings, and **Create and fix later** / **Fix now** — create replays the same quarantine key
and lands each entry on its next-step card (`?created=`, with the Conversion-notes line). Row "…" menu
carries all seven actions; disabled items say why; secondary chips + the all-workflows menu carry
disabled reasons (REQ-PROD-10; the ⌘K palette takes this menu over in P1.06).

**`packages/ui` + `@rhema/api-client`** — `ProjectGroupList`/`VoiceGroupList`/`ProjectRow` (deprecated
flat `ProjectList` kept for older callers); the enriched `ProjectRow`/`CreateProjectDto`/
`ProtocolCardDto`/`ProjectSearchHitDto` types and matching client methods.

## Notes for reviewers

- `listProjectStates` takes `{ deletedOnly }` — the ONLY read that sees soft-deleted rows is the
  restore window (`GET /projects?scope=deleted` → `/app?deleted=1`); the default list predicate is
  `deleted_at is null`.
- Rows missing the new `group` field (older fixtures) fall back to Quiet in `groupByAttention` —
  never dropped.
- The PGlite `case when $8::text is null` cast on the create insert is a parameter-inference workaround;
  it is a no-op on real Postgres.
- Merge policy: **OPERATOR** — do not merge; stacked on `stevevitali/p1-03-autosave-collab-restore`
  (PR #57).
